agenda_items: Review of current period's financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow)
Risk assessment and mitigation strategies for market volatility
Assessment of operational efficiency initiatives impact on financials
Strategic planning for the upcoming period, including budget adjustments
Capital allocation strategy for new fintech product development

Approved reallocation of marketing budget to accelerate user acquisition for new payment gateway.
Decided to increase investment in AI-driven fraud detection systems by [50000, 75000] over the next 6 months.
attendees: Dr. Anya Sharma, Head of Data Analytics
Dr. Ben Carter, Head of Product Strategy
